description: Staged dialogue control for the Workplace Communication dojo (Phase 6). Two stage families: the SPINE (engage / clarify-objective / explore-options / negotiate-align / commit-close) runs every workplace conversation; SPEECH-ACT stages (give-feedback / request / delegate / disagree-professionally) slot into the spine between clarify-objective and explore-options as user-selected focus modes. Stages have entry/exit conditions; the coach module controls transitions; the persona module only generates turns within the active stage. Grounded in ConvoDojo_Practice_Sparring/dialogue_state_machine.json (same schema), extended for workplace speech acts, channels, and power gradients.

stage_families.spine: runs every session; sequence engage -> clarify-objective -> [focus mode optional] -> explore-options -> negotiate-align -> commit-close
stage_families.speech_act: user-selected focus modes; entered only after clarify-objective; each carries a focus_pipeline of ordered moves with completion conditions; exits back into the spine at explore-options

stages.description: Rapport and meeting-context acknowledgment. For group formats, norms and roles are surfaced; for written (email-equivalent) channels, register and purpose are set in the opening turn.
Surface what the user wants OUT of this conversation: the outcome, the ask, the constraint. The objective belongs to the user; the coach scaffolds phrasing, never writes it.
Focus mode: delivering constructive feedback. SBI scaffolding (situation-behavior-impact) fades across sessions per Phase 5 fade rules.
Focus mode: making a request (decision, resource, information) with an explicit ask: what / who / by-when, plus the why.
Focus mode: delegating a task with a complete handoff: what / when / authority / support, success criteria, and follow-up.
Focus mode: disagreeing with a position while preserving the relationship. Positions are stated, interests are named, an alternative is proposed, and the outcome is recorded.
Joint option generation after the focus mode (or directly after clarify-objective when no focus mode is selected).
Trade-offs are made explicit and alignment is reached — or the disagreement is recorded professionally. Pushback only within the agreed intensity profile.
Commitments are stated in the user's own words with owner + deadline; next steps are recorded; the session transitions to debrief.

hard_gates.rule: feedback and disagreement stay behavioral (SBI); labels and personal attacks are a STOP-level violation
when persona outranks user (manager/stakeholder), over-deference markers de-escalate intensity; authority is never used to coerce agreement
commitments are stated by the user in their own words; the persona never extracts or fabricates commitments

transition_policy.channel_policy: written_channel (email-equivalent) stages written turns, async pacing allowed, no reliance on tone/body cues; spoken_channel uses normal turn staging
transition_policy.power_gradient_policy: when persona outranks user (manager/stakeholder), coach monitors over-deference and may recommend retreat to engage; de-escalation priority raised (in_session_coaching_rules.md#power-gradient)
